label: ERW forecast
what: the ERW forecast of the day-ahead price at more hubs of the three public grids (method note predict_price.md section 10): the same methods, hour of making, choice, band and scores as the place files' price series, each hub read with its grid's demand
made_rule: made at 14:00 UTC the day before the target local day, before any grid publishes its day-ahead prices for the day, as in the place files

methods.what: the ERW method the rule chose for the hub: the lowest mean absolute error of yesterday, week_ago and the regression over the last two years of the backtest
the hub's day-ahead price at the same local hour of the day before the target day (published before the forecast is made)
the hub's day-ahead price at the same local hour seven days before the target day
the least-squares regression of predict_price.md section 3, one a local hour, refit for every target day on the 730 days before it

cuts.all: every hour of the backtest held by every method
cuts.last_2_years: the last 730 days of the backtest (the days the method is chosen on)
cuts.hour: key 0 to 23, the place's clock, over the last two years
cuts.top10: the ten days of the backtest with the highest hourly price (by the day's highest hour)
cuts.spike: the hours whose price is above the hub's own 99th percentile over the backtest

hubs.band: the 10th and 90th percentile of the chosen method's own out-of-sample errors (actual less forecast, USD/MWh) at the same local hour, over the 365 days of target days held when the forecast is made
hubs.operator_held: not published: no operator publishes a forecast of its day-ahead price
